description: The JSON collection describes observations from IPMA stations 535, 579 and 762 during December 2018 to February 2019. Variables include temperature, humidity, precipitation, pressure, solar radiation and wind speed/direction. The ILU catalogue explicitly marks these observations as used by public-transport context analysis and bike-sharing demand forecasting. Several units in the source are only described as likely; no definitive unit conversion is applied. Station sampling intervals and completeness are unspecified, and the archived values are not current weather observations. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
